title: Chapter 1 — A Letter to God + Two Frost Poems (Class 10 CBSE English)
subject: English

slides.title: A Letter to God / Dust of Snow / Fire and Ice
What you'll be able to do
bullets: Recall the plot of 'A Letter to God'.
Explain 'Dust of Snow' and its symbolic reversal.
Explain Frost's argument in 'Fire and Ice'.
Connect the three pieces — power of small things.

slides.title: A Letter to God — Setting
bullets: Lencho's lonely farmhouse on a hill.

slides.title: Plot — first half
bullets: Heavy rain comes — but turns to HAILSTONES the size of acorns.
Field WHITE 'as if covered with salt'.

slides.title: Plot — Lencho's letter
bullets: Lencho writes to God for 100 PESOS.
Specific purpose: to plant fields again + live till next harvest.

slides.title: Plot — the postmaster
bullets: Postmaster — fat, AMIABLE — laughs at first.
But: doesn't want to SHAKE Lencho's faith.
Asks employees to contribute + adds his salary.

slides.title: Plot — the reply
bullets: Money in envelope addressed to Lencho.
Lencho comes to post office, takes envelope.

slides.title: Plot — the irony
bullets: Lencho writes a SECOND letter to God.
Accuses post office staff: 'a bunch of crooks'.

slides.title: Themes — A Letter to God
bullets: IRONY — gap between perception and reality.

slides.title: Dust of Snow — by Robert Frost
Dust of Snow — what happens
bullets: Snow shaken loose, falls on speaker.

slides.title: Dust of Snow — symbols
bullets: CROW = traditional symbol of bad luck.

slides.title: Dust of Snow — meaning
bullets: Speaker had RUED the day (regretted it).
Tiny moment SAVES part of the day.

slides.title: Fire and Ice — by Robert Frost
bullets: Question: how will the world end?

slides.title: Fire and Ice — symbols
bullets: Both equally capable of destroying a world.

slides.title: Fire and Ice — relevance
bullets: Climate change — driven by HUMAN DESIRE — is fire.
War and division — driven by HUMAN HATE — is ice.
Personal life — same forces in miniature.
Frost's calm tone makes it more chilling.

slides.title: Connecting the chapter
bullets: Small EVENTS in 'A Letter to God' (storm, letter).
Small EMOTIONS in 'Fire and Ice' (desire, hate).
All have GREAT POWER in human life.

slides.title: You try (5 min)
bullets: 1. Why is the postmaster's response important?
2. Why does Frost choose a CROW and HEMLOCK?
4. What SHOULD Lencho have done after receiving 70 pesos?

slides.title: Quick check
bullets: Q1. How much did Lencho ask for?

slides.title: Key takeaways
bullets: A Letter to God — faith + compassion + irony.
Dust of Snow — small things heal mood.
Fire and Ice — desire and hate equally destructive.
Across the chapter: small things have great power.
